etherscan.note: Requires an API key. Used only as a third, fallback provider by the CLI, CI and the server-side proxy. Not available on Robinhood Chain (4663), Tempo (4217) or Arc (5042).

morphoChains.note: Chains indexed by the Morpho API on 2026-09-04. Vaults on chains without an 'rpc' entry above are identified via the API and the chain check, but on-chain reads are unavailable and every card shows 'single source'.

pinLagNote: pinLag = how many blocks behind the latest block every read is pinned, so that a second provider that lags slightly still has the state. Ethereum 2 (~24 s), Base 5 (~10 s), Robinhood 20 (~5 s).
rpcEntryNote: An rpc entry is a URL, or { url, batch: false } for nodes that reject JSON-RPC batch requests. The first healthy entry is the primary; the next one replays every batch at the same block for comparison; later ones are failover.
